item.title: Grocery costs in Texas: What you need to know
item.description: WalletHub has released a report identifying the states where Americans spend the most and least on groceries.

item.title: Celebrate Okana Resort's anniversary with family fun and food
item.description: OKANA Resort & Indoor Waterpark will celebrate its first anniversary on Feb. 21 with a day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment, food experiences, and a toast to mark the resort's first year of operation.

item.title: Virgin Hotels Dallas hosts monthlong Valentine's festivities
item.description: Virgin Hotels Dallas is hosting a series of Valentine's Day celebrations throughout February, featuring themed menus, live entertainment, luxury room packages, specialty lattes, and festive dining events.

item.title: Dallas bike ride 2026: Explore city landmarks on two wheels
item.description: The Dallas Bike Ride will return on May 16, 2026, welcoming 5,000 riders for a car-free tour of the city.

item.title: Maison de Goudeau IV celebrates Black creative talent
item.description: Maison de Goudeau IV, an immersive fashion exhibition, will take place on Feb. 21 at the Tower Club Dallas, showcasing looks curated by fashion label Stephen Goudeau and supporting Black-owned brands, creatives and service providers.

item.title: Valentine's Day events at Allen Premium Outlets & Firewheel
item.description: Allen Premium Outlets and Firewheel Town Center are hosting a series of Valentine's and Galentine's Day events from Feb. 13-15, featuring retail experiences, arcade play, and multi-course dining.

item.title: Six Flags Over Texas to revamp Mr. Freeze coaster by 2026
item.description: Six Flags Over Texas is giving the Mr. Freeze coaster a makeover, with a new queue area featuring cool scenes and effects, expected to debut in late 2026.

item.title: Germany and U.S. tied as top Winter Olympics medalists since 2001
item.description: Germany and the United States are tied for the most successful nations at the Winter Olympics in the 21st century, with 172 medals each.

item.title: Catch Dallas starts monthly sushi with Tokyo's finest fish
item.description: CATCH Dallas is featuring a monthly sushi program that showcases specialty fish sourced directly from the Toyosu Fish Market in Tokyo, with two limited-time sushi selections each month curated by the restaurant's culinary team.

item.title: 12 bestselling small appliances that are truly kitchen must-haves
item.description: Amazon's bestseller list shows you everything people love for their kitchens because they make mornings smoother, dinners faster and leftovers less sad.
